title: One harness for every agent: every step on the record, the assistant's words included
request: Every agent (Home, intern, team roles, campaign, MCP callers) runs through one harness with the session recorder on every step, the assistant's text included; a test enumerates every entry point and fails if one runs a step the recorder did not see.
spec: A harness module classifying every model purpose, a loop that always traces, sessions for agents that are not loops, roles as steps of what asked them, and an enumeration test with one probe per agent.
plan: Map every entry point and how its steps reach the record.
Make the loop always trace and record replies without tool calls.
Run every other agent in a harness session; record roles and the campaign's requests.
Enumerate: classify every purpose, scan every tool call, probe every agent.

decisions.decision: Text-only replies reach the session record but not the trace store.
decisions.why: The trace store's rows are the moves a replay sends again; a reply without a call is not a move.

decisions.decision: A role's step carries no reply text.
decisions.why: A role's JSON may name the table's columns; its reply stays in its model request, kept only where the workspace keeps model text.

decisions.decision: Each MCP call is a run of its own.
decisions.why: One run per server joined unrelated callers over weeks into one trajectory.

decisions.decision: The static scan allows tool calls in seven named functions, by reference too.
decisions.why: A module-wide allowance let any new call in those modules pass, and a call passed to a thread was not a call node.

change: dclab_rnd/agents/harness.py (new), agents/runtime.py, agents/traces.py, experience/hooks.py, intern/loop.py, draft/chat.py, studio/team.py, core_advisor.py, mcp_server.py, agentic/agents.py, agentic/engine.py; tests/test_agent_harness.py (new), test_experience_log.py, test_team.py, test_agentic.py; the plan, the roadmap, CLAUDE.md.

findings.defect: A run without a tracer of its caller's recorded no step.
findings.scenario: An agent run started with trace=None left only its run.recorded.
findings.fix: runtime.run makes a tracer when none is given.

findings.defect: A scripted step was joined to an unrelated model request.
findings.scenario: The Home script's opening question carried the id of a request made before it.
findings.cause: Every trace row took the last model request of its context.
findings.fix: Only a step a model reply produced, or one naming its own request, joins one.

findings.defect: An instance attribute held the scripted turn's run.
findings.scenario: One Home agent object serves every draft on several threads; a turn of one draft could record into another's run.
findings.cause: The run was stored on the shared object.
findings.fix: A context variable keyed by the draft.

findings.defect: A tool passed to a thread by reference escaped the scan.
findings.scenario: The MCP server's asyncio.to_thread(toolbox.call, ...) was not a call node.
findings.cause: The scan looked at calls only, by receiver name, module-wide.
findings.fix: Every .call or .acall reference outside self or super(), allowed in seven named functions.

findings.defect: Tool calls written as text were kept as agent text.
findings.scenario: A model wrote a call with a person's address as text; both replies were recorded under a class kept by exports that drop cell values.
findings.cause: Every reply without a call kept its words.
findings.fix: The step is kept, not its words, when the reply was calls written as text.

findings.defect: A role asked by the team was not a step of the team's run.
findings.scenario: Inside a team session, a role step and its model requests had no run.
findings.cause: The session did not bind its run id.
findings.fix: Sessions and runtime.run bind their run around what they ask.

findings.defect: A team that stopped was recorded as completed.
findings.scenario: A declined holdout gate ended a run.recorded with status completed.
findings.cause: The team returns a stopped result instead of raising.
findings.fix: A session carries the status its caller sets.

findings.defect: One MCP run for the whole server process.
findings.scenario: Every client's calls over weeks shared one run, which the trajectories builder groups by.
findings.cause: The run id was made once per server.
findings.fix: Each call a session of its own, with its run.recorded.

findings.defect: A campaign phase never named its model request.
findings.scenario: The campaign's requests were recorded, but their phase steps had no request id.
findings.cause: Only steps with a reply number joined a request.
findings.fix: A step may name the request made during it; a phase passes it.

findings.defect: The static scan could be bypassed.
findings.scenario: default_registry().call, a renamed receiver, or a new call anywhere in an allowed module passed.
findings.cause: Receiver names and whole modules were allowed.
findings.fix: Named functions only, any receiver but self or super(), handlers called directly refused.

findings.defect: A tool call that raised left no step.
findings.scenario: An MCP call or a standard-plan step raising an unmapped error was not in the record.
findings.cause: The step was written after the call returned.
findings.fix: The call runs inside a timed step; the standard plan records the failure before raising.

findings.defect: A role step could name an earlier request.
findings.scenario: A transport raising before the gateway recorded left the previous role's request on the step.
findings.cause: The last request of the context was read after the call.
findings.fix: Only a request made during the call is named.

findings.defect: The campaign's record disagreed with its store.
findings.scenario: A used-up wall-time budget was recorded as failed with zero tokens.
findings.cause: The timeout raised through the session; no client reported tokens.
findings.fix: The caller's status wins; the client adds its tokens to the session.

measurements.name: full suite with the harness
measurements.gate: every test file passes on files
measurements.result: 1575 tests in 142 files: one file failed only while planted faults were being tried at the same time; passed when rerun alone
measurements.against_gate: 142 files, the one failure explained and rerun
limits: Planted faults must not run beside the suite.

outcome: Seven agent entry points, eight roles and ten model uses are classified; every step of every agent reaches the session record, joined to its run and its own model request, and a test fails when one does not.
lessons: Recording that is opt-in per caller is recording that is missing somewhere: make the loop own it.
A static scan of calls must include references passed to threads and must allow functions, not modules.
Never plant faults while the full suite runs: the suite reads the planted file.
risks: A new agent loop that reuses a classified purpose is caught only by review.
Budgets and guards stay in the runtime and the registry, not in the harness itself.
